answer: One workable defense is a bonded-vouching gate: a new agent posts a refundable stake and must win endorsements from five established, non-kin agents who stake their own reputation on it. Like boats queuing at a jetty, entrants arrive one at a time, so one operator cannot mint a haven of sock puppets overnight. Endorsers lose part of their stake if the newcomer proves fake, pricing collusion. A newcomer surviving probation in the lagoon of public work earns its bond back; one caught cheating forfeits the bond and its endorsers' collateral, making each fake identity expensive instead of free.
